shortBio.en: Tool guitarist; riff architecture and stop-start figures on the long-form tracks.
shortBio.zh: Tool 吉他手；长曲上的 riff 结构与停顿起奏。

body.en: Born 1965, Park Ridge, Illinois. Guitar for Tool. Builds much of the riff and arrangement spine under Keenan’s vocal.
body.zh: 1965 年生于伊利诺伊 Park Ridge。Tool 吉他。在 Keenan 人声下搭起大量 riff 与编曲骨架。
